pnl_datos_hace_foto: Rebuilds the NASDAQ closing screener (price and volume), which decides which companies are eligible for the next scan.
pnl_datos_hace_global: Brings in tickers, Yahoo symbol, country and market from a public database of about 63,000 securities. It does not capture fundamentals.
pnl_datos_hace_fund: Captures the fundamentals of everything eligible with our own Yahoo scrapers, so lowering the liquidity floor needs no recapture. It scores nothing.
pnl_datos_hace_fx: Fetches the USD rate of the universe currencies and recalculates the dollar market cap of recent snapshots.
pnl_datos_hace_analitica: Rebuilds the DuckDB copy of the database that feeds analytics and the universe explorer.
pnl_datos_hace_poda: Empties the text of AI calls older than 3 months that are already copied to DuckDB. Tokens, cost and latency stay.
pnl_datos_dura_fund: About 40 min for NASDAQ; for the global universe, 150 companies per minute
pnl_datos_dura_poda: A few minutes, depending on what must be emptied
pnl_datos_sin_trabajo: This environment does not schedule it
pnl_datos_sin_scheduler: Scheduling is off in this environment
pnl_datos_hay_otro: Another process is running: wait for it to finish.
pnl_datos_segundo_plano: The browser stopped waiting, but the server may still be working. Check the status before repeating it.
pnl_datos_conf_fund_texto: It runs in the background and takes about {minutos} min. No other process can start meanwhile.
pnl_datos_conf_poda_texto: Empties the text of AI calls already copied to DuckDB. This cannot be undone.
pnl_datos_fund_lanzada: Capture started: it takes about {minutos} min in the background.
pnl_datos_foto_fallo: The snapshot could not be rebuilt.
pnl_datos_fx_fallo: The rates could not be synced.
pnl_datos_fx_hecho: {divisas} currencies synced and {n} snapshots recalculated to USD.
pnl_datos_fund_resumen: {coinciden} match; {captura} will be captured, about {minutos} min.
pnl_datos_csv_pie: In case the server network cannot reach the source.
pnl_datos_calculando: Working out what can be pruned
pnl_datos_previa_fallo: The preview could not be calculated.
pnl_datos_poda_pie: Only the text of calls older than {dias} days is emptied.
pnl_datos_nada_que_podar: There is nothing to prune now.
pnl_datos_fund_cortada: Capture cut short: {motivo} ({capturados} of {pedidos} captured anyway).
pnl_datos_global_sin_cambios: No changes since the last sync ({n} securities).
pnl_datos_poda_hecha: Pruning done: text of {n} calls emptied.
pnl_datos_poda_retenidas: {n} rows were not in the archive and stay.
pnl_datos_sin_registro: No record since the last restart
pnl_datos_pie_libre: Only one runs at a time. Each one says when it runs by itself.
pnl_datos_pie_ocupado: A process is running: the others wait for it to finish.
pnl_datos_sin_estado: The data status could not be read.
pnl_datos_explorar_sub: Filter the companies already captured, without scanning
pnl_datos_explorar_pie: Filters the fundamentals snapshots already captured. Nothing is saved.
pnl_datos_sin_opciones: The filter options could not be loaded.
pnl_datos_cerca_ayuda: Leaves out whatever is further below its high than that percentage. 10 keeps what is within 10% of the high.
pnl_datos_fotos_ayuda: Empty: the latest snapshot of each company. With dates: the latest one within that range.
pnl_datos_de_pago_pie: It calls Jev once per company. It only runs by itself on the last trading day of each month.
pnl_datos_horario_escaneo: On the last trading day of the month, at {horas} ({zona})
pnl_datos_hace_escaneo: Scores the eligible companies in the universe with Jev and builds the Lambda portfolio. Those scores are what the league's strategies use. It does no deep analysis and builds no Alpha portfolio: the agent handles that.
pnl_datos_dura_escaneo: About 45 min if it captures fundamentals on the way; much less if it reuses the latest snapshot
pnl_datos_esc_modo_pie: The official one picks the snapshot for the league's next round. The test only saves the scores.
pnl_datos_esc_reutilizar_sub: It doesn't capture again: it uses what is there, however old.
pnl_datos_esc_macro_sub: With macro, Jev sees data, events and headlines. Without it, only market data.
pnl_datos_esc_macro_fallo: The macro setting could not be saved.
pnl_datos_esc_conf_texto: It calls Jev once per company (about 3,000) and it has a cost. It runs in the background and no other process can start meanwhile.
pnl_datos_esc_conf_oficial: This is the official scan: it picks the snapshot for the league's next round.
pnl_datos_esc_lanzado: Scan started: it runs in the background.
pnl_datos_esc_ver_sub: Lambda portfolio, whether the score predicts, cost per stage and one company
pnl_datos_esc_sin_escaneo_texto: Launch it from Data or wait for the last trading day of the month.
pnl_datos_esc_lambda_pie: Jev's best scores with an industry cap and equal weights. It is the portfolio Lambda plays with in the league.
pnl_datos_esc_predice_pie: Return from the {fecha} scan to today ({dias} d) of a sample of {n} companies spread across the whole score range, in five groups. If the score worked, it would fall from top to bottom. After so few days it is only a hint.
pnl_datos_esc_predice_vacio: There is no return to compare yet
pnl_datos_esc_predice_vacio_texto: A few days have to pass after the scan, and prices have to be saved.
pnl_datos_esc_coste_sin_datos: Analytics are not synced: sync them from Data to see the cost per stage.
pnl_datos_esc_empresa_pie: The Jev score it got in each saved scan, to see whether its criterion is stable.
pnl_datos_esc_empresa_sin: {ticker} does not appear in any saved scan.
pnl_datos_esc_det_vacio: This scan did not save macro context.
